notes: Searched doc_registry_NCT00397189.json resultsSection.outcomeMeasuresModule (sleep latency and sleep maintenance) and adverseEventsModule (eventGroups totals, otherEvents and seriousEvents). No overall Any AE count is posted. The registry otherNumAffected totals 32/394 and 42/395 are non-serious adverse-event subsets with frequencyThreshold 2; seriousNumAffected totals are 1/394 and 3/395. These are not the requested overall adverse-events outcome and were not summed. Used Table 8 Any AE, treatment period (3 weeks), safety population, because it directly reports participants with any AE in the initial randomized comparison. No timepoint was specified. Alternative Any AE counts in the extension period are PRM 394/534 and Placebo 136/177. Table 8 also reports Any SAE, SAE leading to death, DAE, Drug-related AE and Drug-related SAE, which are narrower outcomes.
